uncertain.why: In «جَامِعَ عوالمي الظَّاهِرَةِ» only ONE kasra is printed, under the lam-mim ligature. At 2600 dpi I could not tell whether it belongs to the lam (عَوَالِمي) or the mim (عَوَالمِي). The fatha on ain and waw is certain. Written [؟:عَوَالمِي].

print_errors.note: The quoted verse «أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ» is An-Naml 27:62, but the print gives ٦١. Kept as printed (checked at 1600 dpi).
Tanzil has the waqf sign ۖ after خَلَقَهُۥ. It is not printed; the bracket closes right after the word. Not added. scripts/quran.py flags it (quran_marks).
There is no fatha on the lam (only kasra under the hamza and shadda+fatha on the yeh). The same pattern is on p.108 «لِتُحْسِنَ إِليَّ». Kept as printed (checked at 3000 dpi).
This علىٰ has only the dagger alif and no fathas, while every other على on these pages is عَلَىٰ. Kept as printed (checked at 1800 dpi).

notes:
Markers. p.104 ends with item ٦ complete («…وَيَدِي.») and has no footnotes, so p.105 starts a new item (٧) with no '+'. p.106 continues the 35:10 quotation begun at the end of p.105 («﴿مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ» / «جَمِيعًا﴾ [فاطر: ١٠]»), so it is <<<ص:106+>>>. validate.py needs balanced ﴿﴾ on each line, so the span is closed with ﴾ at the end of p.105 and reopened with ﴿ on p.106; no bracket is printed at the page break. p.107 opens with the new item ١٢ (no '+'). p.108 continues item ١٤ («…فِي أَحْسَنِ صُورَةٍ، صَلِّ» / «وَسَلِّمْ وبَارِكْ…»), so it is <<<ص:108+>>>. p.108 ends mid-sentence («…فَأَخْرَجْتَهُ للوجودِ،»), which continues on p.109.

Red: only the divine Name is red. For يا خالق الأكوان / يا بارئ الأكوان / يا غفار الذنوب / يا مصور بني آدم only the Name word is marked; the following genitive is black. Commas after the Names are black and sit outside the == markers.

Partial vowelling kept exactly as printed (checked at 2000-4000 dpi), for example: وبَارِكْ (waw with no fatha) in every prayer; سَيِّدِنا; عَبْدِ الجبَّارِ and بِقوةٍ and سِواكَ (p.106); عُبودِيَّتِي, والانكسارِ, وَالاضطرارِ; يَقَظَةً and وَمَنامًا (p.105); الْمُؤْمِنينَ and انْتِمائِهِمْ (p.105); تَقْويمٍ (twice in prose on p.107, no kasra on waw; the Quran span has تَقْوِيمٍ); وخُلُقِي; الإيمانِ والأَعْمَالِ; فكانَ; قالَ (no fatha on qaf); باسْمِكَ; بِبشارةِ (kasra only under the first ba); الْعُيوبِ and عُيوبِهِمْ; وقَابِلَ; للوجودِ.

Combined marks over الـ. Where the sukun on the lam and the vowel of the next letter merge into one glyph, I read each case at 3000-4000 dpi: الْمُلْكِ / وَالْمَلَكُوتِ (p.105), الْمَشِيئَةِ (p.106: sukun plus FATHA, not damma), الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ and الْمَعْدُومَ (sukun plus fatha), الْمُصَوِّرِ / الْمُتَحَقِّقِ / الْمُجِيبُ (sukun plus damma).

The Name of Allah printed with a damma (صَلَّىٰ اللهُ, يَا اللهُ, وَصَدَقَ اللهُ) is written اللَّهُ per CONVENTIONS §2.

References keep the printed spacing: [السجدة:٧] has no space after the colon; all the others have one. In the footnote on p.108 the slashes in (١٢/١٩٥) and (١٢/١٠٨) have the same side gaps as each other, so neither is written with a space.

Commas: item ١٠ prints «سَيِّدِنا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِ الجبَّارِ وَعَلَىٰ آلِهِ،» with no comma after محمد or after الجبار. Item ١٢ has «[التين: ٤-٦] يَا اللَّهُ» with no comma. Item ١٥ has «[الفتح: ٢] صَلَاةً» with no comma. All are as printed.
